t: These Milwaukee Boa Flextred black water-resistant safety boots are engineered for demanding trade environments, offering lightweight flexibility and robust durability. Ideal for construction sites, workshops, and outdoor work, these S3 safety boots feature a nubuck water-repellent leather upper for protection against water and dirt. The dual-density PU outsole ensures reliable performance and comfort, complemented by Energy Foam heel cushioning for all-day wear. A BOA speed lacing system provides a fast, secure fit, while the metal-free design with a composite toe cap makes them airport-friendly. Enhanced stability comes from the Roll Cage heel stabilizer, and a Step-Release heel allowing quick removal while a reflective heel loop provides improved visibility. Protection features include a 200J composite toe cap and composite anti-puncture plate (3mm nails PS), along with a TPU scuff cap above the toe area for enhanced abrasion resistance (SC, 8k cycles). Certified ESD protection, fuel oil-resistant outsole (FO), and slip-resistant outsole (SR, ceramic + glycerin) ensure dependable safety and performance across a wide range of jobsite conditions.
b: Safety Rating: S3S ESD FO SC SR
